classroom.title: Class Workspace
classroom.description: Use Class Workspace to organize course recordings and share folders. Instructors can also review the roster and Listening Guy conversations attached to course work.

export-and-sharing.title: Export & Sharing
export-and-sharing.description: Download audio, make a public listening link, or share course recordings through a folder. Choose the option that matches who needs access.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.description: Sign in, choose a recording, and split it into parts you can listen to separately.

index.title: Stem Splitter Documentation
index.description: Play a recording or selected stems, and add notes at specific points.

instructor-console.title: Instructor Console
instructor-console.description: Write teaching instructions for Listening Guy, including terms you want students to use.

listening-guy.title: Listening Guy
listening-guy.description: Ask Listening Guy about a recording. Listening Guy does not receive the recording or its waveforms, so listen to check its descriptions.

live-sessions.title: Live Sessions
live-sessions.description: Lead playback from your mixer while students follow on their own devices. Students can use headphones and adjust the volume on their own devices.

mixer.title: The Mixer
mixer.description: Listen to the parts of a recording on their own or together, slow down a passage, and play it again.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Add a note at a moment in a recording so you and your classmates can find it again.

privacy-and-limits.title: Privacy & Limits
privacy-and-limits.description: Personal work stays in your account unless you share a public link. Your instructor can review work assigned to a course after you check the acknowledgment, and classmates need access through a class folder.

sample-activities.title: Sample Activities
sample-activities.description: Try these listening activities with a recording your class is using.

splitter-basics.title: Splitter Basics
splitter-basics.description: Find your recordings in the Session Rack and learn how to open and manage them.

student-onboarding.title: Student Onboarding
student-onboarding.description: Help students open a recording, listen to its parts, and leave a note.

teaching-tips.title: Teaching Tips
teaching-tips.description: Help students describe specific passages and support their observations.

use-cases.title: Use Cases
use-cases.description: Listen to a recording, make notes, and share it with your class.

course-access.title: Course Access
course-access.description: Enter your course workspace through the Lab. Its maps stay separate from your other projects.

evidence-and-field-notes.title: Evidence & Field Notes
evidence-and-field-notes.description: Connect your map to passages in your memo and use Field Notes to write about your research.

export-and-sharing.title: Export & Sharing
export-and-sharing.description: Share a live project link or an exported copy, and record your progress when your instructor asks.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.description: Accept your course invitation, open a project, and start a map from a memo.

index.title: Systems Mapping Documentation
index.description: Build a map from your research memo and explore the people, organizations, resources, and policies connected to an issue.

instructor-console.title: Instructor Console
instructor-console.description: Write questions and guidance for your course and see how far students have progressed.

levels.title: The Four Levels
levels.description: Map people and places, connect them, and explore how they relate to institutions, resources, and policies.

map.title: The Map
map.description: Add items to a map and describe how they are connected.

memo-and-suggestions.title: Memo & Suggestions
memo-and-suggestions.description: Compare each model suggestion with your memo before deciding what belongs on the map.

privacy-and-limits.title: Privacy & Limits
privacy-and-limits.description: Learn who can see your work and how your memo is used before you share a map.

sample-activities.title: Sample Activities
sample-activities.description: Try these short activities to help students make and discuss their maps.

student-onboarding.title: Student Onboarding
student-onboarding.description: Help students get started with a shared memo and save their first map.

teaching-tips.title: Teaching Tips
teaching-tips.description: Help students decide what to include on their maps and consider how their sources support their choices.

use-cases.title: Use Cases
use-cases.description: Explore ways to use a shared case, community research, or field notes in a mapping assignment.

workspace-basics.title: Workspace Basics
workspace-basics.description: Move between the map and your writing without losing your place in either.
